notes: quince.com directly reachable (HTTP 200, no WAF); robots.txt Claude-SearchBot rules match the prior Home-Decor pass (no full-site Disallow, /shop/pets unrestricted). Checked homepage mega-menu, sitemap_shop.xml and sitemap_subcollections.xml for pet-related URLs: found exactly one Pets department with a single flat listing page at /shop/pets (mega-menu link labelled 'Shop All' under nav section 'Pets' -> slug '/shop/pets'), plus a second URL /shop/accessories/pets found in sitemap_subcollections.xml. Confirmed via __NEXT_DATA__ pageDataJson that /shop/pets and /shop/accessories/pets render the IDENTICAL underlying collection (same TITLE/FILTER_AND_SORT/PRODUCT_LIST widget IDs, same pagination.total=36) -- one row emitted, /shop/pets used as canonical link since it is the primary nav path. No further Pet Care subcategory tree exists on the site: the FILTER_AND_SORT widget only exposes Color/Size/Price/Department facets, not a product-type/category facet, and no other /shop/pets/* or /shop/accessories/pets/* URLs appear in either sitemap. Site reproduces this project's known Quince per-color-variant count-inflation pattern (documented in the prior Home-Decor pass, archive c222): the product-list widget's raw pagination.total=36 counts one row per product-color combination, and the page also has a hard SSR cap (only 30 of the 36 raw rows render server-side, hasMore=true for the rest) which defeated tier-1 direct fetch alone (confirmed ?cursor=30/?offset=30/?page=2 query params are all ignored server-side, exactly as the prior pass found). Escalated to tier 2 (Playwright/Chromium): loaded /shop/pets, scrolled repeatedly to trigger the client-side lazy-load fetch to the real backing API (api-prod-public.onequince.com/presentation-layer-service/widgets/fetch/v1, captured via response listener), which returned all 36 raw rows. Deduplicated by two independent methods that agree exactly: (1) unique canonical product-page href slugs (36 raw <a href> pet-product links in the fully-scrolled DOM strip to 19 unique /unisex/<slug> paths), and (2) the union of internalProductIds across every api.onequince.com/sand-services/products/enrich network call fired during the scroll (18 IDs visible in the first 30 SSR rows + 1 new ID '3460'/'dog-travel-carrier' that only appears after full lazy-load = 19). qty=19 is this deduplicated distinct-product count, not the raw 'total':36 platform figure. All 19 products are Tier-1 decisive Pet Care (dog collars, leashes, harnesses, collar/harness walk-kits, a cashmere dog sweater, a waterproof dog puffer jacket, a cotton pet bandana 3-pack, a leather dog waste-bag holder, and a dog travel carrier) -- no pet-themed-only items, no consumables, no medical/veterinary items found, so no MANUAL REVIEW policy-gap flags apply. Scope check: only Pets department considered; did not pull anything from Women's/Home/other departments.
